title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. The notes study the 'structure at infinity' of the moduli spaces M_{g,ν}. X = D_0 is the compactified moduli space (Deligne–Mumford type, viewed as an orbifold or analytic space). Θ = Θ_0 is the boundary divisor with normal crossings, or the stratification it induces. D_d denotes the (normalised) closed boundary stratum of codimension d. For a strictly decreasing sequence d_* = {d_0 > ... > d_r ≥ 0}, D_{d_*} = D_{d_0,...,d_r} is the space of flags of strata of codimensions d_0, ..., d_r. The family of the D_{d_*} forms a semi-simplicial analytic space over X. Its degeneracies are isomorphisms, which is why the next page restricts to strictly decreasing sequences and to face operators only. D^*_{d_*} is the corresponding open (non-degenerate) stratum.

The previous page sets a 'little programme': make explicit, at the level of homotopy types and fundamental groupoids, the pieces V_{Σ',Σ''} (tubular neighbourhoods of strata relative to other strata) and the transition morphisms between them.

This page makes two points.
(i) A parenthetical correction: the relevant objects are tubular neighbourhoods of the open strata D^*_{d_0,...,d_r}, not of the closed D_{d_0,...,d_r}.
(ii) Grothendieck believes one must also add the analogous types obtained by replacing the pair (X, Θ) = (D_0, Θ_0) by any (D_{d_*}, Θ_{d_*}). That is, each closed stratum, with its own induced boundary divisor, is treated as a new ambient space. This leads to two-index types attached to an inclusion d'_* ⊂ d_*:
- (260) V_{d_*, d'_*} := tubular neighbourhood of the open stratum D^*_{d_*} taken inside D_{d'_*}. It is taken relative to the open part, not the closed one. Upon reflection the superscript * on V is dropped.
- (261) For d'_* = d_* this degenerates to the stratum itself: V_{d_*,d_*} = D^*_{d_*}.
- For d'_* = {0}, i.e. ambient D_0 = X, one recovers the earlier one-index types: V_{(d_1,...,d_{r-1},0),0} = V_{(d_1,...,d_{r-1},0)} = V_{(d_1,...,d_{r-1})}, using the redundancy D_{d_*,0} ≅ D_{d_*}.

The next page names the V_{d_*,d'_*} and V^*_{d_*,d'_*} (deleted neighbourhoods) as the 'building blocks'. Their homotopy types, π_1's and natural maps should determine the full homotopy type at infinity, including the Teichmüller-tower data near the boundary.

In modern terms: one wants a combinatorial/homotopical description of the stratified homotopy type of (M̄_{g,ν}, ∂). This uses iterated homotopy links between strata, indexed by chains of strata, together with the gluing maps. That is essentially the data of the exit-path category, or of a conically stratified space, in the specific case of a normal-crossings boundary.
errors: No mathematical error. The notation is fluid: the formula numbered (260) is ambiguously written (it reads like V_{d'_*,d'_*}) and the index order in the definition is not consistent with the following page. The intended meaning is clear from (261) and from the d'_* = {0} specialisation.

Tubular neighbourhoods of an open (non-closed) stratum inside a closed stratum are not canonically defined as spaces. Only their homotopy types (homotopy links / deleted neighbourhoods) are well defined. The marginal note ('il faut préciser ... voisinage tubulaire') seems to acknowledge this gap. The page does not resolve it.

ideas.what: Use tubular neighbourhoods of open strata, iterated over flags of strata d_0 > ... > d_r, as building blocks of the homotopy type at infinity of M_{g,ν}.
ideas.modern_name: Homotopy links / holinks of a stratified space; exit-path category; conically stratified spaces
ideas.usually_credited_to: Quinn (homotopically stratified sets, 1988); MacPherson (exit paths, 1990s); Treumann (2009); Lurie (Higher Algebra, Appendix A); Ayala–Francis–Tanaka
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (1984), sections on tame topology and the dévissage of stratified structures and of the Teichmüller tower at infinity (programmatic only, no formalism)

ideas.what: Replace (X, Θ) by each closed stratum (D_{d_*}, Θ_{d_*}) with its induced boundary, giving two-index types V_{d_*,d'_*} for d'_* ⊂ d_*.
ideas.modern_name: Relative/iterated links of strata in a normal-crossings (log) stratification; strata of M̄_{g,n} as products of smaller moduli spaces
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard in stratified-space theory; for M̄_{g,n} the recursive boundary structure is due to Knudsen, Deligne–Mumford and Harvey (curve complex)

ideas.what: Flag spaces D_{d_*} as a semi-simplicial analytic space over X whose degeneracies are isomorphisms, so that only face maps (inclusions of type simplices) are kept.
ideas.modern_name: Semi-simplicial resolution of a normal-crossings divisor (cubical/simplicial hyperresolution)

ideas.what: Taking tubular neighbourhoods of the open strata D^* rather than of the closed D gives (deleted) neighbourhoods carrying local monodromy (Dehn-twist) data.
ideas.modern_name: Deleted neighbourhoods / tangential base points at infinity
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (discussion of the Teichmüller tower and boundary neighbourhoods), at the level of ideas

missed.claim: Grothendieck sketches a programme to present the full stratified homotopy type (and fundamental groupoids) at infinity of M̄_{g,ν} through doubly-indexed iterated tubular neighbourhoods V_{d_*,d'_*} over chains of strata, with each stratum recursively playing the role of the ambient space. The page is only notational; the explicit computation of these pieces and their gluing for M_{g,ν} is not carried out here. Modern exit-path / conically stratified theory supplies the general framework. Explicit treatments for M̄_{g,n} exist in fragments: Teichmüller-tower presentations (Hatcher–Lochak–Schneps, Nakamura), and dual-complex / tropical approaches (Abramovich–Caporaso–Payne, Chan–Galatius–Payne). It is unclear whether this full doubly-indexed system has been written down.
missed.quote: qu'il y a à y ajouter (je crois bien) les types analogues, obtenus en remplaçant (X,Θ) par un (D_{d_*},Θ_{d_*}) quelconque
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Specialists would recognise this as the exit-path category of the boundary stratification. It is mainly historically interesting as an early instance of that viewpoint applied to moduli of curves, rather than a new result.

deep.surprise_reason: A notational and programmatic page refining the indexing of the building blocks (tubular neighbourhoods of open strata, iterated over flags). The underlying idea, describing the stratified homotopy type at infinity of M_{g,n} via links of strata, is announced in Esquisse and is now standard via exit-path categories and stratified homotopy theory. There is no finished result here.
transcription_corrections: Line 1 probably reads '(Ceci en faisant abstraction du fait qu'il s'agit de voisinages tubulaires des D^*_{d_0,...,d_r}, et non des D_{d_0,...,d_r} eux-mêmes !)', not 'Ceci en fin d'attention — fait qu'il'.
'ce qui conduit dans à envisager' should be 'ce qui conduit (dans ce cas, à envisager, en plus des V_{d_0..d_r} et V^*_{d_0..d_r})'; the opening parenthesis is in the original.

(260): the left-hand side has a corrected first index; from (261) and the next page it should be read as V_{d_*,d'_*} := V_{D^*_{d_*}, D_{d'_*}} (tubular neighbourhood of the open stratum D^*_{d_*} inside D_{d'_*}). The underlined remark under it reads roughly 'attention : on est en rapport à D^*_{d'_*} (mais non à D_{d'_*} !)'.
Left annotation next to (260): roughly 'ici, on supprime l'exposant * sur V'.
In the last formula the second index rendered as ∅ is a heavily inked '0' (d'_* = {0}, i.e. ambient D_0 = X): V_{(d_1,...,d_{r-1},0),0} = V_{(d_1,...,d_{r-1},0)} = V_{(d_1,...,d_{r-1})}.
The struck-through phrase includes 'd^*_* = {d^*_0, ..., d^*_r = 0}' and '(quand d_r ≥ 0)'; the replacement word is 'redondants'.
The left margin note is a near-illegible diagonal scribble; the reading 'Il faut préciser que le voisinage est tubulaire' is uncertain.
The page number '160' at bottom left is the archive foliation number.
